generic.Defined scope/population: All open complaint cases awaiting a written acknowledgment to the complainant.
generic.In-scope period: Complaints received since the last acknowledgment queue sweep.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acknowledgment Sent Date, channel, template version and named handler recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of acknowledgments dispatched equals count of cases flagged acknowledgment-due.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent acknowledgment PDF filed with dispatch timestamp and template version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late or undeliverable acknowledgments logged with reason and remedial action.
generic.Test population: All complaints acknowledged in the review window across all jurisdictions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent acknowledged on or before the jurisdiction acknowledgment deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Missed acknowledgment escalated to the Complaints Manager and re-issued same day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledgment sent, dated, filed and linked to the complaint reference.
generic.Evidence location: Complaint case Communications tab plus the document management repository.

steps.title: Open the complaint case in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Open the case from the acknowledgment-due queue.
Confirm the complainant residence state and the policy issue state are both recorded.
Confirm the acknowledgment deadline field is populated.
Done when the case is open with state and deadline confirmed.
verify: Check the case shows a residence state and an acknowledgment deadline.
Pass when both fields are populated and non-default.

steps.title: Select the state acknowledgment template in the document management repository
sop: Select the template matching the complainant residence state, not the policy issue state.
Confirm the template version is the current published version.
Record the template version on the case.
Done when the correct state template version is selected and recorded.
verify: Compare the selected template state code against the complainant residence state.
Pass when the template state matches residence state and the version is current.

steps.title: Populate reference, policy and handler details in the letter body
sop: Insert the complaint reference number and the policy number.
Insert the named handler with direct phone number and email address.
Proofread for merge-field failures before rendering the PDF.
Done when the draft carries reference, policy and named handler contact details.
verify: Read the rendered draft for unresolved merge fields.
Pass when reference, policy and handler contact are present and no merge field is blank.

steps.title: Confirm the preferred contact channel on the CRM record
sop: Check the complainant stated preferred channel of mail, email or portal in CRM.
Where no preference is stated, default to the channel the complaint arrived on.
Record the chosen channel on the case Communications tab.
Done when the dispatch channel is chosen and recorded.
verify: Check the Communications tab shows a channel value.
Pass when the recorded channel matches the stated preference or the documented default.

steps.title: Dispatch the acknowledgment through the selected channel
sop: Send the acknowledgment by the recorded preferred channel.
Capture the dispatch evidence such as mail record, email receipt or portal timestamp.
Do not batch the send beyond the acknowledgment deadline date.
Done when the acknowledgment is sent and dispatch evidence is captured.
verify: Check dispatch evidence exists for the case.
Pass when evidence shows dispatch on or before the acknowledgment deadline.

steps.title: Set Acknowledgment Sent Date on the case to the actual dispatch date
sop: Set Acknowledgment Sent Date to the dispatch date, not the drafting date.
Compare the date against the Regulatory Acknowledgment Deadline field.
Raise a breach entry where the dispatch date is later than the deadline.
Done when the sent date is set and compared against the deadline.
verify: Compare Acknowledgment Sent Date against the deadline field.
Pass when the sent date is on or before the deadline or a breach entry exists.

steps.title: Attach the sent acknowledgment PDF and mark it Customer-Facing
sop: Attach the PDF of the dispatched letter to the complaint case.
Set the attachment classification to Customer-Facing.
File the same PDF to the document management repository under the complaint reference.
Done when the PDF is attached, classified and filed.
verify: Open the case attachments and the repository index for the complaint reference.
Pass when the signed acknowledgment PDF is present in both and marked Customer-Facing.

steps.title: Review the acknowledgment queue for misses
sop: Review cases flagged acknowledgment-due with no Acknowledgment Sent Date.
Re-issue any missed acknowledgment the same business day.
Log each miss with reason and remedial action.
Done when no acknowledgment-due case remains without a sent date or exception entry.
verify: Run the acknowledgment-due queue after the sweep.
Pass when every case shows a sent date or a logged exception with disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: All classified complaint cases requiring an SLA to be applied on the case.
generic.In-scope period: Complaints classified since the last SLA assignment review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: SLA due date, SLA clock start and SLA Reason recorded against the classification.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of classified cases equals count of cases carrying an SLA due date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: SLA basis citation and state calendar version retained on the case.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases with a missing or overridden SLA logged with reason and approver.
generic.Test population: All complaint cases with a classification recorded in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero classified cases with a blank SLA due date.
generic.Exception handling path: SLA gaps routed to the Complaints Manager for same-day correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: SLA due date consistent with the classification and its recorded statutory basis.
generic.Evidence location: Complaint case SLA fields in the workflow/case management tool.

steps.title: Read the complaint classification on the case in the workflow tool
sop: Open the case and read the Complaint Source and Complaint Type fields.
Confirm whether the source is Department of Insurance or internal first-party.
Do not apply an SLA before the classification is recorded.
Done when the classification driving the SLA is confirmed.
verify: Check Complaint Source and Complaint Type are populated.
Pass when both fields carry controlled-list values.

steps.title: Select the DOI-forwarded or internal SLA rule
sop: Apply the state-mandated response days where Complaint Source is Department of Insurance.
Apply the internal 30-day SLA only where the complaint is internal first-party.
Never default a DOI-forwarded case to the internal SLA.
Done when the applicable SLA rule is selected.
verify: Compare the selected SLA rule against the recorded Complaint Source.
Pass when DOI-sourced cases carry the state-mandated SLA rule.

steps.title: Set the SLA clock start to the DOI transmittal date
sop: Read the transmittal date from the DOI inquiry document.
Set the SLA clock start to that transmittal date, not the queue arrival date.
For internal complaints set the clock start to the company Date Received.
Done when the SLA clock start date is set from the correct source date.
verify: Compare the SLA clock start against the transmittal or Date Received value.
Pass when the clock start equals the correct source date.

steps.title: Verify the SLA due date calculation against the state calendar
sop: Confirm the SLA due date field auto-calculated from the clock start.
Confirm weekends and state holidays are excluded per the state calendar.
Recalculate manually where the auto-calculation looks inconsistent.
Done when the SLA due date is verified against the state calendar.
verify: Recount business days from clock start to due date.
Pass when the recount matches the system due date.

steps.title: Enable the T-5 and T-2 reminder notifications
sop: Enable the T-5 and T-2 day reminders on the case.
Address the reminders to the assigned handler and their manager.
Confirm the reminder recipients resolve to active users.
Done when both reminders are enabled with valid recipients.
verify: Open the case notification settings.
Pass when T-5 and T-2 reminders are active for handler and manager.

steps.title: Record the SLA basis in the case SLA Reason field
sop: Enter the statute or regulation citation, or the internal policy reference.
Note the state calendar version used for the calculation.
Avoid free-text that does not name a citation or policy.
Done when the SLA Reason field names the governing basis.
verify: Read the SLA Reason field.
Pass when it contains a citation or a named internal policy reference.

steps.title: Sweep for classified cases missing an SLA due date
sop: Filter the case list for classification set and SLA due date blank.
Assign each gap back to the handler for same-day correction.
Log each gap with reason and disposition.
Done when the gap list is empty or every item is logged.
verify: Re-run the filter after correction.
Pass when no classified case has a blank SLA due date.

steps.title: Sync the SLA due date to the CRM customer view
sop: Confirm the SLA due date propagates to the linked CRM case record.
Correct any CRM record showing a stale or missing due date.
Record the sync check on the case.
Done when CRM and the workflow tool show the same SLA due date.
verify: Compare the SLA due date in CRM and the workflow tool.
Pass when the two dates agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All unassigned complaint cases sitting in the intake routing queue.
generic.In-scope period: Complaints logged since the last routing queue sweep.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assigned To, Assignment Date and jurisdiction routing basis recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cases leaving the unassigned queue equal cases with a named assignee.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment entry retained with routing rule and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Independence or capacity conflicts logged with the reassignment reason.
generic.Test population: All complaints assigned during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero cases assigned to the handler whose decision is under complaint.
generic.Exception handling path: Conflicted or over-capacity assignments returned to the queue for re-routing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Named individual assignee recorded with an assignment timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: Case assignment history in the workflow/case management tool.

steps.title: Open the unassigned complaint queue in the workflow tool
sop: Filter the queue for cases with the Unassigned flag set.
Sort by acknowledgment deadline so the tightest cases route first.
Confirm each case has product line and complainant state populated.
Done when the routing worklist is ordered and complete.
verify: Check each queued case shows product line and state.
Pass when no case lacks the routing attributes.

steps.title: Determine the routing basis from product line and complainant state
sop: Read the product line and complainant state from the case.
Select the specialist pool trained or licensed for that jurisdiction and product.
Record the routing basis on the case.
Done when the eligible specialist pool is identified.
verify: Compare the selected pool against the case product line and state.
Pass when the pool covers both attributes.

steps.title: Run the independence check against the underlying transaction
sop: Identify the handler who made the decision complained of from the source record.
Exclude that handler and their direct supervisor from the candidate list.
Record the independence check outcome on the case.
Done when conflicted candidates are excluded and the check is recorded.
verify: Compare the candidate assignee against the recorded decision-maker.
Pass when the assignee is not the decision-maker on the underlying transaction.

steps.title: Check the candidate specialist open complaint load
sop: Open the per-handler workload view in the workflow tool.
Confirm the candidate is under the per-handler open case cap.
Select the next eligible specialist where the cap is reached.
Done when the selected assignee is under the workload cap.
verify: Read the assignee open case count.
Pass when the count is below the documented cap.

steps.title: Route DOI-forwarded cases to a regulatory casework specialist
sop: Check whether the case is flagged DOI-forwarded.
Where flagged, restrict candidates to specialists marked for regulatory casework.
Record why a non-flagged specialist was used if no flagged specialist is available.
Done when DOI-forwarded cases route to a regulatory casework specialist.
verify: Compare the assignee regulatory casework flag against the case DOI flag.
Pass when every DOI-forwarded case has a regulatory casework assignee or a logged exception.

steps.title: Set Assigned To and Assignment Date and clear the unassigned flag
sop: Set Assigned To to the named individual, never a team mailbox.
Set Assignment Date to the current timestamp.
Clear the Unassigned queue flag on the case.
Done when the case shows a named assignee and an assignment timestamp.
verify: Read Assigned To and Assignment Date on the case.
Pass when a named individual and timestamp are recorded and the queue flag is clear.

steps.title: Notify the assignee and the Consumer Affairs Analyst of the routing
sop: Confirm the assignment notification reached the named assignee.
Copy the Consumer Affairs Analyst where the case carries a regulatory element.
Record the notification on the case activity log.
Done when the assignee and any regulatory support are notified.
verify: Open the case activity log.
Pass when an assignment notification entry exists for the named assignee.

steps.title: Reconcile the routing queue after the sweep
sop: Re-run the unassigned queue after routing.
List any case still unassigned and the reason.
Escalate stale unassigned cases to the Complaints Manager.
Done when every intake case is assigned or logged as an exception.
verify: Compare pre-sweep and post-sweep queue counts.
Pass when cases removed from the queue equal cases with a named assignee.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound formal complaints from consumers, DOIs, regulators and representatives.
generic.In-scope period: Complaints received since the last intake logging cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Date Received, Complaint Source, complainant contact and linked policy number populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Inbound artefacts received equal complaint cases created.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Original inbound artefact attached with its receipt date and source.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unlogged or duplicate inbound items logged with disposition.
generic.Test population: All complaint cases created in the review window across all intake channels.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of cases carry Date Received, source and a linked policy number.
generic.Exception handling path: Cases missing a policy link routed back to intake before assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complaint logged with source, receipt date, policy link and original artefact.
generic.Evidence location: Complaint case record and attachments in the workflow/case management tool.

steps.title: Collect the inbound complaint artefact from the intake channel
sop: Retrieve the letter scan, DOI transmittal PDF, email or call recording reference.
Confirm the item meets the formal complaint definition rather than a service query.
Route non-complaints back to the servicing queue with a note.
Done when a confirmed formal complaint artefact is in hand.
verify: Compare the artefact against the formal complaint definition.
Pass when the item meets the definition or is routed away with a note.

steps.title: Create the complaint case in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Create a new complaint case and capture the system-generated reference.
Set Date Received to the date the company first received the complaint.
Use the mail postmark or DOI transmittal date where later channels delayed it.
Done when the case exists with a correct Date Received.
verify: Compare Date Received against the postmark or transmittal date on the artefact.
Pass when the two dates agree.

steps.title: Record the Complaint Source from the controlled list
sop: Select Direct Consumer, DOI, Other Regulator or Third-Party Representative.
Record the transmitting body name where the source is a regulator.
Do not leave the source as Other without a note.
Done when Complaint Source is set from the controlled list.
verify: Read the Complaint Source value.
Pass when the value comes from the controlled list and is not blank.

steps.title: Attach the original inbound artefact to the case
sop: Attach the letter scan, transmittal PDF, email or call recording identifier.
Name the attachment with the channel and receipt date.
Confirm the attachment opens and is legible.
Done when the original artefact is attached and readable.
verify: Open the attachment from the case.
Pass when the original complaint artefact is present and legible.

steps.title: Link the case to the policy and claim records in Salesforce FSC
sop: Search Salesforce FSC and CRM for the policy number and any claim number.
Create a record link rather than typing a free-text reference.
Raise a data query where the policy cannot be located.
Done when the case is linked to the correct policy and claim records.
verify: Open the linked policy record from the case.
Pass when the link resolves to an existing policy record.

steps.title: Capture complainant identity, contact details and authority to act
sop: Record name, mailing address, phone and email for the complainant.
Where the complainant is not the insured, record their authority to act.
Request written authority where none is held before disclosing policy detail.
Done when contact details and authority status are recorded.
verify: Read the complainant contact block and authority field.
Pass when contact details are complete and authority is recorded or requested.

steps.title: Check the case against existing complaints for duplication
sop: Search open and recent cases by policy number, name and address.
Merge or link the case where the same complaint is already logged.
Record the merge decision and the surviving case reference.
Done when duplication is ruled out or the duplicate is merged.
verify: Re-run the duplicate search on the new case.
Pass when no unmerged duplicate remains for the same complaint.

steps.title: Reconcile intake artefacts to cases created
sop: Count inbound complaint artefacts received in the cycle by channel.
Compare that count against complaint cases created in the same cycle.
Investigate and log every difference with its disposition.
Done when the counts agree or every difference is logged.
verify: Compare the artefact count and the case count for the cycle.
Pass when the counts reconcile or differences carry a disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: All logged complaint cases awaiting classification of type and reason code.
generic.In-scope period: Complaints logged since the last classification review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Complaint Type, NAIC reason code, sub-code and coverage line populated from controlled lists.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged cases equal cases carrying a Complaint Type and reason code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Classification entry retained with the taxonomy version and classifier identity.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases classified as Other logged with rationale and review outcome.
generic.Test population: All complaints classified in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero free-text values stored in the reason-code field.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous classifications escalated to the Consumer Affairs Analyst for adjudication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complaint Type, NAIC reason code and coverage line all set from controlled lists.
generic.Evidence location: Classification fields on the complaint case in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Read the complaint narrative and transmittal on the case
sop: Read the full complaint narrative and any attached transmittal.
Identify who transmitted the complaint to the company.
Note each distinct allegation raised.
Done when the transmitting party and allegations are identified.
verify: Check the case notes list the allegations identified.
Pass when every allegation in the narrative appears in the notes.

steps.title: Set Complaint Type to Regulatory or Internal First-Party
sop: Set Complaint Type to Regulatory where a DOI or regulator transmitted it.
Set Internal First-Party where the consumer or their representative wrote directly.
Do not classify on subject matter, classify on the transmitting party.
Done when Complaint Type reflects the transmitting party.
verify: Compare Complaint Type against the recorded Complaint Source.
Pass when the two are consistent.

steps.title: Record DOI transmitting state, file number and analyst contact
sop: Where DOI-forwarded, record the transmitting state and DOI file or tracking number.
Record the DOI analyst name, phone and email from the transmittal.
Leave these fields blank only for internal first-party complaints.
Done when DOI identifiers are recorded for regulatory complaints.
verify: Compare the DOI file number on the case against the transmittal document.
Pass when the numbers match for every regulatory complaint.

steps.title: Select the NAIC reason code and sub-code
sop: Select underwriting, marketing and sales, claim handling or policyholder service.
Select the sub-code that matches the primary allegation.
Use the controlled list only and never type free text.
Done when reason code and sub-code are selected from the list.
verify: Inspect the stored reason-code value type.
Pass when the value is a controlled-list code with no free text.

steps.title: Set the coverage line and product code for ratio reporting
sop: Read the coverage line and product code from the linked policy record.
Set the matching values on the complaint case.
Correct any mismatch against the policy administration record.
Done when coverage line and product code match the policy.
verify: Compare case coverage line against the linked policy record.
Pass when the values agree so the complaint rolls to the right denominator.

steps.title: Flag privacy, discrimination or producer-conduct elements
sop: Screen the allegations for privacy, discrimination or producer-conduct content.
Set the corresponding parallel-routing flag on the case.
Record a nil finding where no such element exists.
Done when parallel-routing flags are set or a nil finding is recorded.
verify: Read the parallel-routing flags and the nil finding note.
Pass when each case shows a flag or an explicit nil finding.

steps.title: Quality-check classifications against the narrative
sop: Sample classified cases and re-read the narrative against the code chosen.
Correct codes that default to the most common value.
Record the sample result and the taxonomy version used.
Done when the sample is checked and corrections are applied.
verify: Compare sampled codes against the narratives.
Pass when sampled codes match the narrative allegation.

steps.title: Sweep for unclassified cases before handover
sop: Filter for logged cases with Complaint Type or reason code blank.
Classify each remaining case or log it as an exception with rationale.
Escalate any case unclassified beyond the agreed window.
Done when no logged case is left unclassified without an exception.
verify: Re-run the unclassified filter.
Pass when the result set is empty or every item carries a disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: All acknowledged complaints requiring a timeline and next-steps communication.
generic.In-scope period: Complaints acknowledged since the last communications review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Expected resolution date, named specialist, channel and template version recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledged cases equal cases with a timeline communication logged.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Outbound communication retained with template version and dispatch timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases without a timeline communication logged with reason and remedy.
generic.Test population: All timeline communications issued in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Communicated resolution date matches the case SLA due date in every case.
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatched dates corrected and a revised communication issued to the complainant.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Timeline communication logged with channel, template version and timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: Case Communications tab in CRM and the document management repository.

steps.title: Read the SLA due date from the complaint case
sop: Open the case in the workflow tool and read the SLA due date.
Confirm the date is current and not superseded by an extension.
Note the date to be quoted to the complainant.
Done when the expected resolution date is confirmed.
verify: Compare the noted date against the case SLA due date field.
Pass when the two dates are identical.

steps.title: Draft the timeline communication from the approved template
sop: Open the approved timeline template in the document management repository.
State the expected resolution date rather than a generic wording.
Record the template version used.
Done when the draft names a specific resolution date.
verify: Read the draft for a specific calendar date.
Pass when a dated commitment replaces any generic phrasing.

steps.title: Insert the named specialist and direct contact details
sop: Insert the assigned specialist name, direct dial and email.
Confirm the contact details resolve to the current assignee.
Update the draft where the case has been reassigned.
Done when the draft names the current assignee with working contact details.
verify: Compare the named contact against the case Assigned To field.
Pass when the names match.

steps.title: Describe the next steps and any information needed
sop: List the information the company will gather during the investigation.
List any documents needed from the complainant with a response-by date.
Avoid internal system names and jargon in the wording.
Done when next steps and complainant actions are stated plainly.
verify: Read the next-steps section of the draft.
Pass when company actions and any complainant actions are both stated.

steps.title: Add DOI contact details and escalation rights where required
sop: Check whether the complainant state requires DOI contact details in communications.
Insert the state DOI address and phone where required.
State the consumer right to escalate alongside the internal route.
Done when required regulatory referral wording is present.
verify: Compare the draft against the state requirement in the jurisdictional register.
Pass when required DOI details appear for states that mandate them.

steps.title: Dispatch the communication on the recorded channel
sop: Send by the channel recorded on the case Communications tab.
Capture the dispatch receipt or portal timestamp.
Re-send by an alternative channel where delivery fails.
Done when the communication is dispatched and evidence captured.
verify: Open the dispatch evidence on the case.
Pass when evidence shows successful dispatch on the recorded channel.

steps.title: Log the communication with channel, timestamp and template version
sop: Create the communication log entry on the case in CRM.
Record channel, dispatch timestamp and template version.
Attach the dispatched document to the case.
Done when the log entry and attachment both exist.
verify: Read the communication log entry fields.
Pass when channel, timestamp and template version are all recorded.

steps.title: Reconcile communicated dates against SLA due dates
sop: Extract the communicated resolution dates for the period.
Compare each against the case SLA due date.
Correct and re-communicate any mismatch found.
Done when every communicated date matches its SLA due date.
verify: Run the comparison across the period population.
Pass when no mismatch remains uncorrected.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaint cases routed to a specialist and awaiting assignment acceptance.
generic.In-scope period: Assignments made in the last business day and any still open from earlier.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acceptance entry, acceptance timestamp and conflict declaration recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assignments made equal acceptances recorded plus logged reassignments.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acceptance entry retained with the accepting user identity and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed or declined acceptances logged with reassignment reason.
generic.Test population: All assignments made in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No assigned case older than one business day without an acceptance entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Unaccepted cases reassigned by the Complaints Manager with the reason recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acceptance logged by the same user ID as the Assigned To field.
generic.Evidence location: Case assignment history in the workflow/case management tool.

steps.title: List assignments awaiting acceptance in the workflow tool
sop: Filter cases where Assigned To is set and no acceptance entry exists.
Sort by assignment timestamp so the oldest surface first.
Note cases approaching the one business day window.
Done when the pending acceptance list is produced.
verify: Check the list covers every assigned case with no acceptance entry.
Pass when the filter returns all such cases.

steps.title: Prompt the assignee to click Accept Assignment on the case
sop: Send the acceptance prompt to the named assignee.
State the one business day acceptance window.
Record the prompt on the case activity log.
Done when the assignee has been prompted and the prompt logged.
verify: Open the case activity log.
Pass when a prompt entry exists for each pending case.

steps.title: Accept the assignment on the case
sop: Open the assigned case and review the complaint summary.
Click Accept Assignment within one business day of routing.
Decline with a reason where the case cannot be taken.
Done when the case is accepted or declined with a reason.
verify: Read the acceptance entry on the case.
Pass when acceptance or a reasoned decline is recorded.

steps.title: Record the conflict of interest declaration
sop: Check the policy, claim and prior handler against your own involvement.
Record a nil conflict declaration where none exists.
Declare and decline where you handled the underlying decision.
Done when a conflict declaration is recorded either way.
verify: Read the conflict declaration field on the case.
Pass when a declaration exists for every accepted case.

steps.title: Check the acceptance user ID matches Assigned To
sop: Compare the acceptance entry user ID against the Assigned To user ID.
Investigate any acceptance logged by a different user.
Correct the assignment record where a delegate accepted in error.
Done when acceptance and assignment identities agree.
verify: Compare the two user IDs on each accepted case.
Pass when they are identical.

steps.title: Reassign cases where the acceptance window lapsed
sop: Identify cases past one business day with no acceptance.
Reassign to an eligible specialist under the workload cap.
Record the lapse reason and the new assignee on the case.
Done when every lapsed case is reassigned with a recorded reason.
verify: Re-run the pending acceptance filter after reassignment.
Pass when no case exceeds the window without a reassignment record.

steps.title: Reconcile assignments to acceptances for the cycle
sop: Count assignments made in the cycle.
Count acceptances recorded plus reassignments logged.
Investigate and log any difference.
Done when the counts reconcile or differences are logged.
verify: Compare the assignment and acceptance counts.
Pass when they reconcile or each difference carries a disposition.

steps.title: Confirm accepted cases show correct SLA ownership
sop: Confirm the accepted case shows the SLA due date and reminders addressed to you.
Correct reminder recipients where the case was reassigned.
Record the confirmation on the case.
Done when SLA ownership follows the accepted assignee.
verify: Read the reminder recipient list on the case.
Pass when reminders address the current accepted assignee.

generic.Defined scope/population: All new complaints requiring a jurisdictional acknowledgment deadline to be set.
generic.In-scope period: Complaints logged since the last deadline determination run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Regulatory Acknowledgment Deadline, citation and register version recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged complaints equal complaints carrying an acknowledgment deadline.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Register entry version and citation retained against the calculated deadline.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or stale register entries logged as maintenance tickets with disposition.
generic.Test population: All complaints with a deadline determined in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every deadline carries a supporting statutory citation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unlisted states escalated to the Compliance Analyst and a register ticket raised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deadline date populated with citation and a current register review date.
generic.Evidence location: Case deadline fields plus the jurisdictional register in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Read the complainant state from the complaint case
sop: Open the case and read the complainant residence state.
Confirm the state is taken from the complainant address, not the policy issue state.
Correct the state where the address indicates otherwise.
Done when the governing state is confirmed.
verify: Compare the recorded state against the complainant mailing address.
Pass when the state matches the address.

steps.title: Look up the state acknowledgment window in the GRC register
sop: Open the jurisdictional requirements register in the GRC platform.
Find the acknowledgment window for the complainant state.
Note whether the window counts calendar or business days.
Done when the state acknowledgment window is identified.
verify: Compare the noted window against the register entry.
Pass when the window and day-count basis match the register.

steps.title: Apply the shorter of statutory and internal service standard
sop: Compare the state statutory window against the internal service standard.
Select the shorter of the two as the governing window.
Record which standard was selected and why.
Done when the governing window is selected and recorded.
verify: Compare the selected window against both candidate windows.
Pass when the shorter window was applied.

steps.title: Calculate and set the Regulatory Acknowledgment Deadline
sop: Calculate the deadline from Date Received using the governing window.
Set the Regulatory Acknowledgment Deadline field with the calendar date.
Recheck the day-count basis before saving.
Done when the deadline date is set on the case.
verify: Recalculate the deadline from Date Received.
Pass when the recalculated date equals the stored deadline.

steps.title: Record the statutory citation and register version
sop: Record the statute or bulletin reference supporting the window.
Record the register entry version used for the derivation.
Avoid recording a citation not present in the register.
Done when citation and register version are stored on the case.

steps.title: Run the analytics completeness rules on closed cases
sop: Check reason code, root cause, outcome, remedy amount and dates are populated.
Correct any field failing the completeness rules.
Hold cases that cannot be completed from the release.
Done when released cases pass the completeness rules.
verify: Run the completeness rule set on the release list.
Pass when every released case passes.

steps.title: Release the case into the analytics extract queue
sop: Set the analytics release flag on the qualifying closed cases.
Confirm the queue picks the cases up for the next scheduled load.
Record the release timestamp on each case.
Done when qualifying cases are released to the queue.
verify: Read the queue contents before the load.
Pass when every released case is present.

steps.title: Confirm the case appears in the scheduled load
sop: Check the BI load result after the scheduled run.
Confirm the released cases landed in the reporting layer.
Investigate any case that did not load.
Done when released cases are confirmed loaded.
verify: Query the reporting layer for the released case references.
Pass when each is present.

steps.title: Work the load exception report
sop: Review rejections for invalid codes or illogical dates.
Assign each rejection to the owning handler for correction.
Reload corrected records in the next cycle.
Done when every rejection is assigned and corrected.
verify: Re-run the exception report after correction.
Pass when no closed case remains unresolved on it.

steps.title: Confirm de-identification or access restriction
sop: Confirm personal data is de-identified or access-restricted per policy.

Escalate where personal data is exposed beyond policy.
Done when the loaded data meets the access policy.
verify: Read the dataset access configuration.
Pass when it matches the documented policy.

steps.title: Record the extract batch reference on the case
sop: Capture the extract batch reference from the load.
Record it on each released complaint case.
Use it to trace the case in later analysis.
Done when every released case carries a batch reference.
verify: Read the batch reference field on released cases.
Pass when each is populated.

steps.title: Reconcile released cases to loaded records
sop: Count cases released for the cycle.
Count records loaded plus records on the exception report.
Investigate and log any residual difference.
Done when released and loaded counts reconcile.
verify: Compare the released and loaded counts.
Pass when they reconcile including exceptions.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaints closed in the period assembled into the analysis dataset.
generic.In-scope period: The analysis cycle period being aggregated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reason code, root cause, product, state and outcome present on every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dataset row count and remedy total agree to the complaint register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dataset version and extract date stamped on the published file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded duplicates and merged reopens logged with the exclusion rule.
generic.Test population: All rows in the published analysis dataset for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No duplicate complaint reference present in the dataset.
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciliation breaks investigated before the dataset is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dataset version and extract date recorded with a reconciled row count.
generic.Evidence location: BI platform dataset store with the version stamp.

steps.title: Extract closed complaints for the period from the register
sop: Extract complaints closed in the period from the complaint register.
Include reason code, root cause, product, state and outcome.
Record the extract parameters used.
Done when the raw extract is produced with the required columns.
verify: Check the extract column set.
Pass when all required fields are present.

steps.title: Reconcile row count and remedy total to the register
sop: Compare the extract row count to the register closed count.
Compare the remedy total to the register remedy total.
Investigate every difference before analysing.
Done when both totals reconcile or differences are explained.
verify: Compare the two counts and the two totals.
Pass when both reconcile.

steps.title: Apply and document the exclusion rules
sop: Exclude duplicates and reopened-then-merged cases.
Document the exclusion rule applied and the rows removed.
Keep the excluded rows in a separate audit file.
Done when exclusions are applied and documented.
verify: Read the exclusion log against the removed rows.
Pass when every removal is covered by a documented rule.

steps.title: Join in policy-in-force counts by product and state
sop: Join in-force policy counts by product and state at period end.
Confirm the join key matches the dataset product and state values.
Flag any combination with no matching in-force count.
Done when in-force counts are joined for ratio computation.
verify: Check for dataset rows with a null in-force denominator.
Pass when unmatched combinations are flagged rather than silently null.

steps.title: Check for duplicate complaint references
sop: Run a duplicate check on the complaint reference column.
Remove or merge any duplicate found and record the action.
Re-run the check after correction.
Done when the dataset holds one row per complaint reference.
verify: Run the duplicate check on the final dataset.
Pass when no duplicate reference is present.

steps.title: Version and date-stamp the dataset
sop: Apply a version number and extract date to the dataset.
Store the extract query alongside it for reproducibility.
Lock the version once published.
Done when the dataset is versioned, dated and locked.
verify: Read the dataset version metadata.
Pass when version and extract date are both recorded.

steps.title: Publish the dataset to the analysis consumers
sop: Publish the versioned dataset to the BI analysis workspace.
Notify the analysis consumers of the version available.
Retire the prior version from active use.
Done when the dataset is published and the prior version retired.
verify: Open the published dataset from the workspace.
Pass when the current version is the only active one.

generic.Defined scope/population: All completed root-cause analyses and their supporting evidence for the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Analysis cycles completed since the last archive run.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Analyses completed equal archive records created for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive record retained under write-once protection with a version stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records blocked from archive logged with the blocker and resolution.
generic.Test population: All archive records created in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No analysis record disposed of before its retention date.
generic.Exception handling path: Legal holds suppress disposal and are recorded on the archive record.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive record present with retention period and disposal review date set.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository plus the document management repository.

steps.title: Package the analysis, dataset and action evidence
sop: Assemble the root-cause analysis, supporting dataset and action evidence.
Create one archive package per analysis cycle.
Include the dataset version and analysis date.
Done when the cycle package is assembled.
verify: Read the package contents list.
Pass when analysis, dataset and action evidence are all included.

steps.title: Determine the longest applicable retention period
sop: List the states covered by the analysis.
Apply the longest retention period across those states.
Record the state driving the retention choice.
Done when the retention period is determined and recorded.
verify: Compare the applied period against the state retention table.
Pass when the longest applicable period was used.

steps.title: Index the archive by period, product line and category
sop: Index the record by analysis period, product line and root-cause category.
Confirm the index supports query-based exam retrieval.
Correct any index key left blank.
Done when all three index keys are populated.
verify: Query the archive by each index key.
Pass when the record is retrievable on all three.

steps.title: Apply write-once protection to the archive record
sop: Apply write-once protection so the record cannot be silently amended.
Confirm amendments create a new version rather than overwriting.
Record the protection setting on the archive entry.
Done when write-once protection is confirmed active.
verify: Attempt an amendment on the archived record.
Pass when the amendment is blocked or versioned.

steps.title: Set the disposal review date
sop: Set the disposal review date from the retention period.
Confirm the disposal queue reads that date.
Correct any record with no review date.
Done when the disposal review date is set.
verify: Read the disposal review date on the archive record.
Pass when it is set and consistent with the retention period.

steps.title: Confirm no legal hold blocks future disposal
sop: Check the analysis subject matter against active legal holds.
Suppress disposal where a hold applies and record it.
Re-check holds at each disposal review.
Done when hold status is recorded on the archive record.
verify: Compare the disposal queue against the active hold list.
Pass when no held record appears in the disposal queue.

steps.title: Reconcile completed analyses to archive records
sop: Count analyses completed in the cycle.
Count archive records created for the same cycle.
Investigate and log every difference.
Done when the counts reconcile or differences are logged.
verify: Compare the two counts.
Pass when they agree or each difference carries a disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open corrective actions requiring an accountable named owner.
generic.In-scope period: Actions raised since the last ownership assignment review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named owner, deputy, acceptance date and owning function recorded per action.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open actions equal actions with a named accepted owner.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unaccepted actions logged and escalated to the function head.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Named individual owner and acceptance date recorded on every open action.
generic.Evidence location: Corrective action register in the GRC platform.

steps.title: List open actions without a named individual owner
sop: Filter the GRC action register for open actions.
Identify entries owned by a team, department or mailbox.
Order by due date so the tightest are assigned first.
Done when the unassigned or generically owned list is produced.
verify: Read the owner field on each listed action.
Pass when every generic owner is captured in the list.

steps.title: Identify the function that controls the failing process

Reject complaints as the owning function for process fixes.
Record the owning function on the action.
Done when the controlling function is identified per action.
verify: Compare the owning function against the failing process.
Pass when the owner sits in the controlling function.

steps.title: Assign one named individual per action
sop: Assign a single named individual to each action.
Reject team names and shared mailboxes as owners.
Record the owner role and contact on the action.
Done when each action names one individual owner.
verify: Read the owner value on each action.
Pass when every action names an individual.

steps.title: Obtain owner acceptance with a date
sop: Ask the owner to accept the action in the register.
Record the acceptance date rather than assigning unilaterally.
Chase acceptance before the five day escalation point.
Done when acceptance is recorded or chased.
verify: Read the acceptance field and date.
Pass when every open action shows an acceptance date.

steps.title: Name a deputy for each action
sop: Record a deputy owner for each action so absence does not stall it.
Confirm the deputy is aware of the action and its due date.
Update the deputy when the owner changes.
Done when each action carries a named deputy.
verify: Read the deputy field on each action.
Pass when every open action names a deputy.

steps.title: Escalate actions unaccepted after five business days
sop: Identify actions with no acceptance after five business days.
Escalate each to the function head with the due date at risk.
Record the escalation on the action.
Done when every stale action is escalated.
verify: Compare unaccepted actions against escalation entries.
Pass when each carries an escalation record.

steps.title: Reflect ownership on the linked complaint cases
sop: Record the action owner on the linked complaint cases in the workflow tool.
Confirm the complaint handler can see who owns the fix.
Correct stale owner references after reassignment.
Done when linked complaint cases show the current action owner.
verify: Compare the owner shown on the case against the register.
Pass when the two agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaints in the analysis period requiring a root-cause category.

generic.Exception handling path: Above-threshold Other volumes reworked before the analysis is published.

generic.Evidence location: Case classification fields plus the BI classification dataset.

steps.title: Classify each complaint to a root-cause category
sop: Assign process failure, system error, staff error or product design.
Assign the sub-category from the taxonomy.
Record the taxonomy version applied.
Done when category and sub-category are assigned.
verify: Read the category fields for the period.
Pass when every complaint carries both values.

steps.title: Run a second-reviewer check on a sample

Re-classify independently and compare against the original.
Record the agreement rate and the disputed items.
Done when the sample is re-classified and compared.
verify: Read the sample agreement rate.
Pass when the rate meets the agreed consistency threshold.

steps.title: Reconcile classification against the free-text findings
sop: Compare classifications against the free-text findings narrative.
Correct codes that default to the most common value.
Record the corrections made.
Done when classifications match the narratives.
verify: Sample narratives against their categories.
Pass when the categories are supported by the narratives.

steps.title: Drive the Other and Unclassified bucket down
sop: Measure the Other and Unclassified share of the period.
Rework those complaints into specific categories where possible.
Record why any residual entry cannot be classified.
Done when the residual share is below threshold or explained.
verify: Compute the Other and Unclassified share.
Pass when it is below the agreed threshold.

steps.title: Record the taxonomy version used
sop: Record the taxonomy version applied to the period.
Note any category added or retired since the prior period.
Flag trend comparisons affected by taxonomy change.
Done when the taxonomy version and changes are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded taxonomy version.
Pass when it is present and matches the classification cycle.

steps.title: Publish the classified dataset to the BI platform
sop: Load the classified complaints into the BI classification dataset.
Confirm the load rejects nothing on invalid categories.
Correct and reload rejected rows.
Done when the classified dataset loads without rejections.
verify: Read the load exception report.
Pass when no classification row remains rejected.

steps.title: Sweep for complaints with no category
sop: Filter the period for complaints with a blank category.
Classify each or record why it cannot be classified.
Escalate residual blanks before publication.
Done when no complaint in the period lacks a category.
verify: Re-run the blank category filter.
Pass when it returns no unexplained records.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaint-driven script, template or procedure changes agreed with operations.
generic.In-scope period: Changes agreed since the last operations change review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: New version number, effective date, compliance review and briefing evidence recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Agreed changes equal published versions plus withdrawn superseded versions.

generic.Exception handling path: Compliance rejections returned to drafting before publication.

generic.Evidence location: Document management repository plus the production knowledge base.

steps.title: Draft the revised script, template or procedure wording
sop: Draft the specific wording change that removes the complaint driver.
Show the before and after wording side by side.
Reference the complaint root cause the change addresses.
Done when the revised wording is drafted with the change shown.
verify: Read the draft change record.
Pass when before and after wording and the root cause are recorded.

steps.title: Route disclosure wording through compliance review
sop: Identify whether the wording carries a disclosure or regulatory statement.
Route it for compliance review where it does.
Record the compliance decision on the change record.
Done when compliance has reviewed regulated wording.
verify: Read the compliance decision on the change record.
Pass when regulated wording shows a recorded review.

steps.title: Publish the updated document with a new version number
sop: Publish the document with a new version number and effective date.
Store it under the same document identifier in the repository.
Notify the document owner of the publication.
Done when the new version is published with an effective date.
verify: Read the published version metadata.
Pass when version number and effective date are both set.

steps.title: Retire the superseded version
sop: Withdraw the superseded version from active use.
Confirm it can no longer be selected in the production tooling.
Retain it in the archive for evidential purposes.
Done when the old version is withdrawn but retained.
verify: Search the production tooling for the old version.
Pass when it is not selectable but remains archived.

steps.title: Brief the contact centre and operations teams
sop: Brief affected teams on the change before the effective date.
Record attendance or read receipts as briefing evidence.
Repeat for absentees before they next handle the process.
Done when affected staff are briefed with evidence recorded.
verify: Compare briefing evidence dates against the go-live date.
Pass when briefing evidence predates go-live.

steps.title: Confirm the change is live in the knowledge base and scorecard
sop: Confirm the change is live in the production knowledge base.
Confirm the quality scorecard reflects the new expectation.
Correct any channel still showing the old guidance.
Done when the change is live in both places.
verify: Open the knowledge base and the scorecard.
Pass when both reflect the new version.

steps.title: Close the corrective action with evidence
sop: Attach the published version, withdrawal record and briefing evidence.
Close the linked corrective action with the go-live date.
Leave the action open where any element is missing.
Done when the action is closed with complete evidence.
verify: Read the closed action evidence set.
Pass when publication, withdrawal and briefing evidence are all attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: All prioritised root causes requiring a documented corrective action plan.
generic.In-scope period: Root causes prioritised in the current corrective action cycle.

generic.Exception handling path: Milestone slippage triggers automatic escalation from the register.

generic.Evidence location: Corrective action register in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Break the plan into milestones with individual dates
sop: Break the fix into discrete milestones.
Set an individual due date per milestone.
Reject plans expressed as a single end date.
Done when the plan has dated milestones.
verify: Read the milestone list and dates.
Pass when more than one dated milestone exists.

steps.title: State the interim control limiting customer harm
sop: Define the interim control that limits harm before the permanent fix lands.
Name who operates the interim control and how often.
Record it on the plan.

verify: Read the interim control section.
Pass when a control, an operator and a frequency are recorded.

steps.title: Record the expected reduction and proving measure
sop: Record the expected complaint volume reduction from the fix.
Record the measure that will prove the reduction.
Confirm the measure can be produced from the reporting data.
Done when expected reduction and measure are recorded.
verify: Read the expected reduction and measure fields.
Pass when both are present and the measure is reportable.

steps.title: Obtain business owner and consumer affairs approval
sop: Obtain documented approval from the accountable business owner.
Record the consumer affairs manager approval alongside it.
Do not load the plan without both approvals.
Done when both approvals are documented.
verify: Read the approval entries on the plan.
Pass when both approvers and dates are recorded.

steps.title: Load the plan into the GRC action register
sop: Load the milestones and dates into the action register.
Link the plan to the driving root cause and complaint cases.
Confirm the register displays each milestone separately.
Done when the plan is loaded and linked.
verify: Open the plan from the root-cause record.
Pass when each milestone appears as a tracked item.

steps.title: Configure automatic escalation on milestone slippage
sop: Enable slippage escalation on each milestone.
Address escalations to the owner and the consumer affairs manager.
Test the escalation fires on a past-due milestone.
Done when slippage escalation is configured and tested.
verify: Check escalation settings on the milestones.
Pass when escalation is enabled on every milestone.

steps.title: Review plans without interim controls or milestones
sop: Filter the register for plans with one date or no interim control.
Return each to the owner for rework.
Log any plan accepted as is with the rationale.
Done when no deficient plan remains unaddressed.
verify: Re-run the deficiency filter.
Pass when no plan lacks milestones or an interim control.

generic.Defined scope/population: All prioritised root causes requiring corrective actions to be specified.

generic.Evidence location: Corrective action register in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Match the action type to the cause category
sop: Select process redesign for process failure and defect fix for system error.
Select retraining or coaching for staff error.
Select wording or product change for product design.
Done when the action type matches the cause category.
verify: Compare the action type against the cause category.
Pass when the two are aligned.

steps.title: Specify the exact artefact to change
sop: Name the procedure section, system field or rule, training module or policy clause.
Reject actions that name only a team or an outcome.
Record the artefact identifier and current version.
Done when the artefact and its version are named.
verify: Read the artefact field on the action.
Pass when a specific artefact and version are named.

steps.title: Test whether the fix applies to other states or lines
sop: Check whether the same artefact drives complaints in other states or products.
Widen the action scope where it does.
Record the scope decision and the analysis behind it.
Done when the scope breadth is tested and recorded.
verify: Read the scope decision on the action.
Pass when the decision cites cross-state or cross-line analysis.

steps.title: Assess whether a filing or regulator notification is needed
sop: Check whether the change requires a form filing or rate action.
Check whether a regulator notification precedes implementation.
Record the assessment and any dependency on the action.
Done when the filing requirement is assessed and recorded.
verify: Read the filing assessment field.
Pass when the assessment is recorded for every product or wording change.

steps.title: Reject monitor-only and remind-staff actions
sop: Review the action wording for monitor or remind formulations.
Return such actions for redesign against a named artefact.
Record the rejection and the resubmission.
Done when no action remains a monitor or reminder only.
verify: Search action descriptions for monitor and remind wording.
Pass when none remains in the approved set.

steps.title: Record residual risk where the cause cannot be eliminated
sop: Record the residual risk accepted where full elimination is not possible.
State the compensating control that limits the residual exposure.
Obtain manager acceptance of the residual risk.
Done when residual risk and its acceptance are recorded.
verify: Read the residual risk entry.
Pass when risk, control and acceptance are all recorded.

steps.title: Load the designed actions to the register
sop: Load each designed action into the GRC action register.
Link it to the root cause and the driving complaint cases.
Confirm the workflow tool shows the action against those cases.
Done when the actions are loaded and linked.
verify: Open an action from a driving complaint case.
Pass when the link resolves in both systems.

generic.Defined scope/population: All delivered corrective actions requiring an outcome and lessons-learned record.

steps.title: Record what changed, when and who confirmed it
sop: Record the delivered outcome against each action.
State what changed, the go-live date and who confirmed it.

Done when the delivered outcome is recorded with a date and confirmer.
verify: Read the outcome narrative.

steps.title: Attach the evidence artefact

steps.title: Record the lessons learned entry

Done when the lessons learned entry is recorded.

Pass when it names the detection gap, not just the failure.

steps.title: Link the outcome to the driving complaint cases
sop: Link the outcome record back to the complaint cases that triggered the action.
Record the outcome reference on those cases in the workflow tool.
Confirm the loop is traceable in both directions.
Done when the outcome and complaints are linked both ways.
verify: Open the outcome from a driving complaint case.
Pass when the link resolves in both directions.

steps.title: File the outcome pack to the evidence repository
sop: File the outcome narrative and artefact in the compliance evidence repository.
Index it by root-cause code and period.
Record the repository location on the action.
Done when the pack is filed and indexed.
verify: Search the repository by root-cause code.
Pass when the outcome pack is retrievable.

steps.title: Publish the entry to the consumer affairs knowledge base
sop: Publish the lessons learned entry to the knowledge base.
Tag it with the root-cause code so future analysts find it.
Confirm the entry is searchable after publication.
Done when the entry is published and searchable.
verify: Search the knowledge base by root-cause code.
Pass when the entry is returned.

steps.title: Review outcome records before action closure
sop: Review each outcome record against the plan and the evidence.

Record the review decision on the action.

verify: Filter closed actions for missing evidence.
Pass when the filter returns none.

steps.title: Compare the current ratio against three reference points

Compare against the same period last year and the internal tolerance.
Record all three comparatives per line.

steps.title: Explain variances above the agreed percentage

Reference the supporting analysis for each driver.

steps.title: Separate real deterioration from definitional effects

Test for backlog clearance or a one-off event.
Record the classification for each variance.
Done when each variance is classified as real or artefact.
verify: Read the variance classification.
Pass when each carries a real or artefact classification.

steps.title: Highlight threshold breaches by state

Highlight each in the comparison output.
Route each to the escalation process.

verify: Compare the breach list against escalation entries.
Pass when every breach is routed.

steps.title: Review the commentary before publication
sop: Review the drivers and classifications for plausibility.
Challenge generic commentary that names no driver.
Record the review decision on the output.
Done when the commentary is reviewed and recorded.
verify: Read the review record on the comparison.
Pass when a reviewer and date are recorded.

steps.title: Retain the comparison as period report evidence

Link it to the period report as supporting evidence.
Record the version and analysis date.
Done when the comparison is retained and linked.
verify: Open the comparison from the period report.
Pass when the link resolves to the versioned output.

steps.title: Check every published ratio was compared

Compare against ratios carrying a comparison line.
Complete any missing comparison before issue.
Done when every published ratio has a comparison.
verify: Compare the two counts.
Pass when they agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All state and line combinations monitored for spikes and threshold breaches.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation record retained with detection date and dashboard version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dismissed alerts logged with the rationale for no escalation.
generic.Test population: All detected breaches in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Escalation raised within one business day of detection.
generic.Exception handling path: Late escalations logged with the delay reason and containment applied.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Threshold breach flagged with a detection date and a containment action.
generic.Evidence location: BI monitoring dashboard plus the GRC escalation record.

steps.title: Monitor the ratio and volume dashboard against the rules
sop: Review the dashboard against the spike and threshold rules per state and line.
Confirm the rules are the current agreed versions.
Record the review date and dashboard version.
Done when the dashboard is reviewed against current rules.
verify: Read the monitoring review record.
Pass when review date and rule version are recorded.

steps.title: Record the detection date for each breach
sop: Record the date the breach was detected, not the date it occurred.
Distinguish detection from occurrence in the record.
Do not wait for the monthly cycle to record detection.
Done when each breach carries a detection date.
verify: Read the detection dates on the breach list.
Pass when each breach has one.

steps.title: Raise the escalation within one business day
sop: Raise the escalation within one business day of detection.
Do not defer to the monthly reporting cycle.
Record the escalation timestamp.
Done when the escalation is raised inside the window.
verify: Compare escalation timestamp against detection date.
Pass when the gap is within one business day.

steps.title: State the affected scope, size, duration and driver
sop: State the affected state and line in the escalation.
State the size and duration of the breach.
State the suspected driver with its supporting data.
Done when scope, size, duration and driver are stated.
verify: Read the escalation content.
Pass when all four elements are present.

steps.title: Notify the state compliance officer where exposed
sop: Determine whether the breach carries market conduct exposure.
Notify the compliance officer for the affected state where it does.
Record the notification on the escalation.
Done when exposed breaches trigger a state notification.
verify: Read the notification record on exposed breaches.
Pass when each shows a state officer notification.

steps.title: Track the escalation to a containment action
sop: Record a containment action with owner and due date.
Do not close the escalation on acknowledgement alone.
Track the containment through to delivery.
Done when each escalation carries a tracked containment action.
verify: Read the containment action on each escalation.
Pass when every escalation has one with an owner.

steps.title: Reconcile detections to escalations
sop: Count breaches detected in the window.
Compare against escalations raised plus documented dismissals.
Investigate and log every difference.
Done when detections and escalations reconcile.
verify: Compare the two counts.
Pass when they reconcile including dismissals.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaint drivers analysed for volume, detriment and systemic character.

generic.Exception handling path: Confirmed systemic drivers handed to root-cause prioritisation with evidence.

generic.Evidence location: Driver analysis output in the BI platform.

steps.title: Rank drivers by volume and by weighted detriment
sop: Rank complaint drivers by volume for the period.
Rank separately by weighted customer detriment.
Report both rankings rather than one composite.
Done when both rankings are produced.
verify: Read both ranking outputs.
Pass when volume and detriment rankings are both present.

steps.title: Run verbatim analysis on complaint narratives
sop: Run text analysis across the complaint narratives for the period.
Identify drivers the coded reason fields do not capture.
Record the additional drivers found.
Done when free-text analysis is run and drivers recorded.
verify: Read the free-text analysis output.
Pass when it exists for the period alongside the coded analysis.

steps.title: Test each candidate driver for systemic character
sop: Test whether the driver spans multiple handlers, states or months.
Reject candidates confined to a single handler or one-off event.
Record the systemic test result per driver.
Done when every candidate has a systemic test result.
verify: Read the systemic test results.
Pass when each candidate carries a recorded outcome.

steps.title: Trace top drivers to the responsible process element
sop: Trace each top driver to the process step, letter, system rule or product feature.
Name the specific element rather than the owning team.
Record the trace with supporting case examples.
Done when each top driver names a responsible element.
verify: Read the traced element per top driver.
Pass when each names a specific process element.

steps.title: Reconcile driver volumes to the period total
sop: Sum the driver volumes and compare against the period complaint total.
Investigate overlaps or complaints counted under two drivers.
Record the reconciliation.
Done when driver volumes reconcile to the period total.
verify: Compare the summed driver volumes against the period total.
Pass when they reconcile.

steps.title: Hand systemic drivers to prioritisation
sop: Pass each confirmed systemic driver to the root-cause prioritisation cycle.
Attach the supporting evidence and traced element.
Record the handover date.
Done when systemic drivers are handed over with evidence.
verify: Read the prioritisation input list.
Pass when every confirmed systemic driver appears.

steps.title: Publish the driver analysis for the period
sop: Publish the driver analysis with both rankings and the traces.
Record the dataset version used.
Notify the reporting consumers.
Done when the analysis is published and versioned.
verify: Open the published analysis.
Pass when rankings, traces and dataset version are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaint register records subject to the periodic data quality checks.
generic.In-scope period: The period being checked before the monthly extract lock.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reason code, state, product, dates, outcome and remedy amount populated.

generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved exceptions escalated to the Complaints Manager before lock.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Completeness, timeliness and validity checks run with an exception list.
generic.Evidence location: Data quality output in the BI platform plus register exception records.

steps.title: Run the completeness check on mandatory fields
sop: Check reason code, state, product, dates, outcome and remedy amount.
List records with any mandatory field blank.
Record the completeness result for the period.
Done when the completeness check is run and listed.
verify: Read the completeness exception list.
Pass when it covers all mandatory fields.

steps.title: Run the timeliness check on logging delay
sop: Compute Date Received to Date Logged for each record.
List exceptions where the gap exceeds 24 hours.
Group the exceptions by handler.
Done when the timeliness check is run and grouped.
verify: Read the timeliness exception list.
Pass when exceptions are listed by handler.

steps.title: Run the validity check on codes and date logic
sop: Check reason codes map to live NAIC codes.
Check dates fall in logical sequence across the case lifecycle.
List every validity failure.
Done when the validity check is run and failures listed.
verify: Read the validity exception list.
Pass when code mapping and date logic are both tested.

steps.title: Sample closed cases for coding accuracy
sop: Sample closed cases and re-read the narrative against the reason code.
Record agreement and correct mis-coded records.
Report the accuracy rate for the period.
Done when the accuracy sample is complete.
verify: Read the sampled accuracy rate.
Pass when the rate is reported and corrections applied.

steps.title: Assign exceptions to owning handlers with deadlines
sop: Assign each exception to the owning handler.
Set a correction deadline before the monthly extract locks.
Notify the handler and their manager.
Done when every exception is assigned with a deadline.
verify: Read the exception assignment list.
Pass when each exception has an owner and a deadline.

steps.title: Re-run the checks before period lock
sop: Re-run the three checks after corrections.
Escalate any exception still open before the lock.
Record the final exception position.
Done when the re-run result is recorded before lock.
verify: Read the post-correction exception count.
Pass when no unresolved exception remains at lock.

steps.title: Report recurring quality issues to coaching
sop: Identify handlers with repeat data quality exceptions.
Share the pattern with the complaints manager for coaching.
Record the referral without disciplinary content in the register.
Done when recurring issues are referred for coaching.
verify: Read the coaching referral record.
Pass when repeat exception patterns are referred.

generic.Defined scope/population: All live internal complaint reason codes requiring mapping to external code sets.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period whose code set version applies.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Internal code, NAIC code, state code and mapping version recorded per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Live internal codes equal mapped codes in the mapping table.

generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped codes resolved by compliance before the submission runs.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Version-controlled mapping covering every live internal reason code.
generic.Evidence location: Mapping table in the workflow tool plus the regulatory filing tracker.

steps.title: List the live internal reason codes
sop: Extract the live internal reason code list from the workflow tool.
Include codes used in the period even if since retired.
Record the extract date.
Done when the live code list is produced.
verify: Compare the list against codes present in the period data.
Pass when every used code appears.

steps.title: Map each internal code to NAIC and state code sets
sop: Map each internal code to the NAIC reason and disposition codes.
Map to any state-specific code list that applies.
Leave no live code unmapped.
Done when every live code carries an external mapping.
verify: Filter the mapping for unmapped internal codes.
Pass when the filter returns none.

steps.title: Confirm the code set version matches the period
sop: Check the external code set version effective for the reporting period.
Confirm the mapping table version matches it.
Update the mapping where the code set changed.
Done when the mapping version matches the period code set.
verify: Compare the mapping version against the code set effective date.
Pass when they align.

steps.title: Resolve one-to-many mappings with a deterministic rule
sop: Identify internal codes mapping to more than one external code.
Define a deterministic rule using another field to disambiguate.
Record the rule with the mapping entry.
Done when every ambiguous mapping has a deterministic rule.
verify: Read the ambiguity rules on the mapping.
Pass when no ambiguous mapping is left unresolved.

steps.title: Run the extract and check for default codes
sop: Run the reporting extract using the mapping.
Filter for records landing on an unmapped or default bucket.
Correct the mapping or the source record for each.
Done when zero records fall to a default code.
verify: Re-run the default code filter on the extract.
Pass when it returns no records.

steps.title: Obtain compliance review of the mapping change
sop: Review any mapping change before it is applied to a live submission.
Record the review decision and reviewer.
Block application where the review is outstanding.
Done when mapping changes carry a compliance review.
verify: Read the review record on the mapping version.
Pass when every change shows a reviewer and date.

steps.title: Publish the versioned mapping to the filing tracker
sop: Publish the approved mapping version to the regulatory filing tracker.
Record which submissions use that version.
Retire the superseded version from active use.
Done when the approved version is published and linked to submissions.
verify: Open the mapping version referenced by a submission.
Pass when it is the approved version for that period.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaint metrics reported quarterly to the compliance committee and leadership.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter with prior-quarter and prior-year comparatives.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Volume, ratio, reason codes, root causes, SLA performance and DOI data recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every headline figure reconciles to the complaint register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued report retained with version and register extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: SLA breaches reported with their causes and remediation status.
