generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Prior-quarter actions carried forward with current status in every report.
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciliation breaks resolved before the report is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report issued for the quarter with a reconciliation note and extract date.
generic.Evidence location: Quarterly report stored in the GRC platform with BI supporting extracts.

steps.title: Assemble volume, ratio, reason and root-cause figures
sop: Assemble quarterly volume, ratio, top reason codes and root causes.
Include prior-quarter and prior-year comparatives.
Record the extract date for each figure.
Done when the core metric set is assembled with comparatives.
verify: Read the metric set and comparatives.
Pass when both comparison periods are present.

steps.title: Include SLA and statutory deadline performance
sop: Report SLA and statutory deadline performance for the quarter.
List breaches with their causes and remediation status.
Do not report performance without the breach detail.
Done when deadline performance and breaches are reported.
verify: Read the deadline performance section.
Pass when breaches and causes are both present.

steps.title: Include DOI-forwarded volume and adverse dispositions
sop: Report DOI-forwarded complaint volume by state.
Report any adverse regulator disposition in the quarter.
Link each adverse disposition to its follow-up action.
Done when DOI volume and dispositions are reported.
verify: Read the DOI section.
Pass when volume by state and adverse dispositions both appear.

steps.title: Carry forward the prior quarter actions
sop: List the prior quarter actions with their current status.
State delivery progress rather than restating the commitment.
Flag actions overdue past their extension.
Done when prior actions are carried forward with status.
verify: Compare the carried-forward list against the prior report.
Pass when every prior action shows a current status.

steps.title: Reconcile every headline figure to the register
sop: Reconcile each headline figure back to the complaint register.
Resolve differences before issue.
Note the extract date on the pack.
Done when all headline figures reconcile.
verify: Recompute the headline figures from the register.
Pass when the recomputation matches the pack.

steps.title: Review and approve the report before issue
sop: Review the pack for accuracy, completeness and clarity.
Challenge figures without a reconciliation note.
Record the approval before distribution.
Done when the report is approved for issue.
verify: Read the approval record on the report version.
Pass when approver and date are recorded.

steps.title: Issue and store the quarterly report
sop: Issue the report to the compliance committee and senior leadership.
Store the version in the GRC platform with the supporting extracts.
Record the issue date and distribution list.
Done when the report is issued and stored.
verify: Open the stored report version.
Pass when it matches the issued version and lists recipients.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaint patterns relevant to underwriting, claims and product management.

sop: Cover declinations, non-renewals, rating disputes and application handling.
Include volume and detriment for each pattern.
Exclude patterns underwriting does not own.

steps.title: Produce the claims pattern cut
sop: Cover delay, denial, settlement adequacy and adjuster communication.
Include volume and detriment for each pattern.
Exclude patterns claims does not own.

verify: Read the claims cut contents.

steps.title: Produce the product pattern cut
sop: Cover wording clarity, disclosure and expectation-gap complaints.
Include the product and wording clause implicated.
Exclude service-only patterns.

verify: Read the product cut contents.
Pass when it covers wording, disclosure and expectation themes.

steps.title: Include example cases and verbatim extracts
sop: Include example case references for each pattern.
Include verbatim extracts that illustrate the customer experience.
Redact identifying detail not needed by the recipient.

verify: Open an example reference and read a verbatim.

steps.title: Distribute the cuts and log the distribution
sop: Distribute each cut to its function contact.
Log the distribution date and recipients.
Restrict access to nominated recipients.

verify: Read the distribution log.

steps.title: Diarise the remediation follow-up
sop: Diarise a follow-up with each function after distribution.
Confirm whether remediation was raised or the finding rejected.
Record the outcome per pattern.
Done when each function response is recorded.
verify: Read the follow-up outcomes.
Pass when every function confirmed action or rejection.

steps.title: Escalate patterns left unactioned
sop: List patterns with no action and no rejection rationale.
Escalate each to the consumer affairs manager for the next cycle.
Record the escalation against the pattern.
Done when unactioned patterns are escalated.
verify: Compare unactioned patterns against escalation entries.
Pass when each carries an escalation record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All complaint records responsive to an examiner data request.

steps.title: Log the examiner request in the exam tracker
sop: Log the request scope, population definition and due date.
Record the examiner contact and request reference.
Confirm the interpretation of scope with the examiner where ambiguous.
Done when the request is logged with scope and due date.
verify: Read the tracker entry.
Pass when scope, population definition and due date are recorded.

steps.title: Pull the population on the examiner date basis
sop: Pull the complaint population on the received or closed basis as stated.

Record the reconciliation with the production set.

steps.title: Review for privilege, third-party data and scope
sop: Review for privileged material and third-party personal data.
Remove out-of-scope records and redact where required.
Log every withholding with its basis.
Done when the review and redactions are complete and logged.
verify: Sample the production for privileged or third-party content.
Pass when none is present unredacted.

steps.title: Produce in the requested format with an index
sop: Produce in the examiner requested format.
Apply a Bates or index reference to every document.
Build the production index listing every item.
Done when the production is formatted and indexed.
verify: Compare the index against the production contents.
Pass when every document carries an index reference.

steps.title: Transmit the production and record the transmittal
sop: Transmit the production by the examiner required channel.
Record the transmittal date and receipt confirmation.
Escalate where the due date is at risk and request an extension.
Done when the production is transmitted and confirmed.
verify: Compare the transmittal date against the request due date.
Pass when production is inside the due date or an extension is recorded.

steps.title: Retain the production set, index and transmittal
sop: Retain the production set, index and transmittal in the evidence repository.
Index by exam reference and production date.
Record the storage location in the exam tracker.
Done when all three artefacts are retained and located.
verify: Search the evidence repository by exam reference.
Pass when set, index and transmittal are all retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: All state annual complaint data calls due in the filing calendar.

steps.title: Confirm template version and due date from the filing calendar
sop: Read the state data call template version and due date.
Confirm the version against the state publication.
Record both on the filing calendar entry.
Done when template version and due date are confirmed.
verify: Compare the recorded version against the state publication.

steps.title: Extract on the state prescribed population basis

Extract the complaint population on that basis.
Record which basis was applied.
Done when the extract uses the prescribed basis.
verify: Compare the basis used against the state instruction.

steps.title: Run the template validation rules
sop: Run the template validation rules over the populated file.
Clear every error and warning before submission.
Record any warning accepted with its rationale.
Done when validation is clear or accepted warnings are recorded.
verify: Read the validation report.
Pass when no uncleared error remains.

steps.title: Reconcile totals to the register and prior year
sop: Reconcile the submitted totals to the complaint register.
Compare against the prior year submission for plausibility.
Explain material movements before submitting.
Done when totals reconcile and movements are explained.
verify: Recompute the totals from the register.
Pass when they agree and movements carry commentary.

steps.title: Obtain sign-off before submission
sop: Review the validated file, reconciliation and commentary.
Record the sign-off with name, date and file version.
Block submission without sign-off.

steps.title: Submit the data call and capture the confirmation
sop: Submit through the state required channel before the due date.
Capture the submission confirmation reference.
Retry and escalate where submission fails.

verify: Compare the submission date against the calendar due date.

steps.title: File the submission artefacts in the filing inventory
sop: File the submission confirmation, submitted file and validation report.
Link them to the filing calendar entry.
Close the calendar entry once filed.
Done when all artefacts are filed and the entry closed.
verify: Open the filing calendar entry.
Pass when confirmation, file and validation report are all attached.

verify: Read the reconciliation note attached to the submission.

steps.title: Check the mapping version applied

Confirm the version is the one effective for the period.

steps.title: Confirm validation errors were cleared

verify: Read the validation report and override notes.

steps.title: Confirm the approver named on the filing calendar
sop: Check the filing calendar for the named approver for this filing.

verify: Compare the signed version against the submitted version.
